text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Palmer and Daitaku Helios gave it 
their all in the Takarazuka Kinen. 
Inspiring one another, they charged toward 
the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, it's discovered that the 
Mejiro family matriarch was in the 
audience. In contrast to Mejiro Palmer's 
flustered reaction, Grandma's expression 
seemed to soften.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next target is the Tenno Sho (Autumn). 
She challenges authority once more to see 
if she can find freedom in this 
prestigious race.
